statement: wiiuse accepts builtin or external inactive MP IDs, then initializes one MP context. Its 04/05 mapping, mapped 04/05/07 handshake and alternating gyro/child parser have no second-MP recursion or separate second gyro. Thus external MP on Plus or nested MPs cannot be credited with independently decoded dual sensors; physical first-unit identity remains unknown. L2CAP acceptance is not a UHID host result.

applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. wiiuse motion_plus.c 45-104, 106-160, 177-235, 238-370; #52 E1/E2/E3 not run.
